source: public/media/films/<file>.webp, 2560x1440 (the shipped plates), measured at full resolution
units: 0-1 plate fractions, [x of width, y of height], the lib/media.ts marks tuple format. A line mark is [0, y] (as the existing horizon marks). wheelR is [rx/width, ry/height]: the axis-aligned half-extents of the wheel's OUTER rim, so wheel +/- wheelR is its bounding box in the same units (a scalar radius does not fit the tuple type; ry = the radius as a fraction of plate height).

details.MV-10.horizon: the valley floor's far edge at the mountains' foot (the haze glow band). Per 4%-column bands over x .50-.98: glow peak median .3354, mountain-foot edge (strongest dark-to-bright Sobel-y) median .3313; visually the line sits on the foot of the ranges. The land line tilts from about .32 at x .55 to .345 at x .95; .333 is the band median. Ridge skyline (not used): .22-.30. The far tree line in the valley: .368.
details.MV-10-alt.horizon: the alt differs from MV-10 only in the left tree mass; the right half measures the same to within .0007 (glow .3358, foot .3313).
details.iconic-deadeye.horizon: the mountains' foot where the rolling foothills begin (bright-to-dark row edge at .437-.442 over x .40-.55 and .80-.88; .453 over x .73-.80). Alternatives the builder may prefer: the ridge skyline against the sky .37-.39 (strongest edge), the flat fields' far edge .48.
details.iconic-camp.lake: the lake's far waterline (dark far shore above, lit water below): strongest positive Sobel-y row at y 543-546 px over x .20-.40 (median .3778); flat across the open water.
details.iconic-camp.wheel: the fully visible wagon wheel at the right (hub-side of the tent). Rim fitted as a rotated ellipse by maximising the radial gradient along the rim (tent-occluded arc 330-100 deg excluded): centre (2274, 816) px, rx 90, ry 98.5 px at -7.5 deg on the felloe mid-line; outer rim confirmed by luma profiles (top edge y 712, left edge x 2179). Outer half-extents 96 x 104 px -> wheelR [.0375, .0722]. The iron hub sits at [.8932, .5681] (perspective: 0.005 right of the rim centre). The 2000-px estimate (r .062) was about 14% small.
details.iconic-camp-alt.lake: far waterline: y 525 px at x .19-.22 rising to 532-534 px over x .33-.52; median .3698 -> .369.
details.iconic-camp-alt.wheel: two full wagon wheels (similar size). Chosen: the RIGHT wheel (smaller, so the front wheel by wagon convention; unoccluded; nearer frame centre): outer ellipse centre [.4344, .5837], half-extents [.0195, .0517]; hub [.4354, .5851]. The other wheel, if a builder prefers it: centre [.3623, .5840], half-extents [.0227, .0556], hub [.3664, .5851].
details.iconic-hall.tableL/tableR: the high table's top edge = its lit lip: row luma peaks at y 919-920 px and drops to the dark apron at 921 over x .42-.62 -> .6385. Ends from the apron's dark band (rows 922-927) against the lit wall: left x 1018 px (.398), right x 1629 px (.636). The existing highTable mark [.5, .63] could become [.517, .6385] (the table's centre) if a builder wants it consistent.
details.iconic-hall-alt.tableL/tableR: lit lip y 906-909 px, apron dark from 910 -> .6306. Ends from the apron band (rows 911-916): left x 821 (.321), right x 1619 (.632). The existing highTable [.47, .64] could become [.4765, .6306].
